_about: Tracked record of notices owed to / sent to data providers. The pipeline copies the matching entries into each source's provenance on every run (provenance entries are rewritten each run, so a hand-edited field there would be lost). Add new entries here; never delete sent ones.

notifications.subject: Where is the current Land_and_Ocean_summary.txt? The S3 file was last updated Jan 2025
notifications.dataset_version_at_notification: Land_and_Ocean_summary.txt (S3 object last modified 2025-01-10; analysis run 2025-01-04; data through 2024)
notifications.covers: Notice of use of the annual Land+Ocean global anomaly (air-above-sea-ice version, 1951-1980 reference, plus a computed 1850-1900 offset) in a publicly accessible, non-commercial dashboard shared within the sender's personal network; CC BY-NC terms and attribution acknowledged.
context: The file's 2024 value (+1.311 C vs 1951-1980 = 1.617 C above the computed 1850-1900 offset) reproduces Berkeley Earth's January 2025 report (1.62 +/- 0.06).

The January 2026 report gives 2025 as 1.44 +/- 0.09 C above 1850-1900, ~0.08 C cooler than 2024 and 0.03 C cooler than 2023, implying ~1.52 C for 2024 and ~1.47 C for 2023: ~0.10 C and ~0.065 C below the file (1.617 / 1.535).

S3 file serves 200 (Last-Modified 2025-01-10); data.berkeleyearth.org/auto/Global/Land_and_Ocean_summary.txt returns 403; berkeleyearth.lbl.gov does not respond (checked 2026-10-02 from two machines).
questions: Where does the current, regularly updated version of Land_and_Ocean_summary.txt (or an equivalent annual global series) live?
Is the S3 bucket still the canonical source or has it been superseded, and is the 2025 analysis in the January 2026 report based on a different vintage or method that should be used instead?

replies.subject: Re: Where is the current Land_and_Ocean_summary.txt? The S3 file was last updated Jan 2025
replies.text: Berkeley Earth switched to our high resolution dataset as the operational product. Its available here: https://berkeleyearth.org/data/ (annual file here).
replies.note: Settles which file is current; migration is ENHANCEMENTS.md decision 83. vintage_reconciled stays unset until that PR merges.
